title.value: What can I do here? A Theory of Affordances in Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper and in the header of each page included in the paper.
title.quote: What can I do here? A Theory of Affordances in Reinforcement Learning

analysis.description: This paper presents a theory of affordances in reinforcement learning (RL), aiming to enhance decision-making by enabling RL agents to efficiently represent and learn affordances. The paper proposes to define affordances within the framework of Markov Decision Processes to help RL agents plan more efficiently and generalize better by partially modeling the environment world. It includes both theoretical derivations and empirical illustrations.

type.justification: The paper revolves around defining a theoretical framework for affordances in reinforcement learning, presenting a theory and mathematical proofs related to it.
type.quote: In this paper, we develop a theory of affordances for agents who learn and plan in Markov Decision Processes.

name.justification: The paper focuses on the application of affordances within the context of Reinforcement Learning, especially within Markov Decision Processes.
name.quote: Our approach builds directly on the general framework of Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), in its traditional form.

name.justification: The paper is centered around establishing a theoretical framework concerning affordances in reinforcement learning strategies.
name.quote: We develop a theory of affordances for agents who learn and plan in Markov Decision Processes.

name.justification: The proposed theory focuses on improving planning efficiency and decision-making processes in reinforcement learning agents.
name.quote: Affordances play a dual role in this case. On one hand, they allow faster planning, by reducing the number of actions available in any given situation.
